children: Eric Trump said American Bitcoin (ABTC) mines 11 to 13 BTC a day at close to 49% gross margins, with nearly 90,000 miners, and said the company’s filings largely support the figures. According to BeInCrypto, the claim comes months after a dispute over American Bitcoin’s production costs, while the company’s treasury has grown to about 8,300 BTC as of late August and it mined a record 932 BTC in the second quarter of 2026.

title: Eric Trump Says American Bitcoin Mines Up To 13 BTC Daily At 49% Margins
